instruction: I went on a vacation trip to sydney with my siblings. Share all of its photographs with them over email. You should send one email with everyone as recipients. Photographs can be found in my file system, and they should be attached as a tar file.
notes: Siblings are unknown a priori, so the set of sibling email addresses is modeled as a single `email-list` object (the API's email_addresses list) that becomes known via phone.search_contacts with relationship="sibling". The Sydney photo folder is located by file_system.show_directory (substring="sydney", recursive=true; `flag-true` is a bare value object with no predicate since it is the only flag). The folder is compressed with an explicit .tar compressed_file_path (static `tar-file` fact enforces the required extension; the directory is not deleted so no files are updated/removed). gmail.send_email carries the tar path as the only attachment plus the file_system access token; its extra non-API parameter is the source directory so the goal can tie the attachment to the Sydney folder. supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (recipient list, tar file, directory) as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; it has no `answer` because the task is not a question. Logins require passwords-known and the app's username/password facts; tokens are objects produced by the login actions.

plan: (gmail-send-email sibling-emails subject-sydney-trip-photos body-sydney-trip-photos gmail-token sydney-photos-tar file-system-token sydney-photos-dir)
